name: When is it better to replace a fence instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace a fence instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider replacing a fence if more than 20-30% of its structure is damaged, if multiple posts are rotted or broken, or if the cost of repairs approaches or exceeds half the cost of a new fence. If the fence is very old and showing widespread deterioration, or if you frequently face recurring issues after repairs, a full replacement can be a more cost-effective long-term solution. Maine Results, Inc. can advise on the best option based on your fence's condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace a fence if over 20-30% is damaged, repair costs are high, or it's very old with widespread deterioration.
